prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1114; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to what happened, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine, we'll note it as withheld for now. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision occurred?

A: I was driving on the highway in Conroe, in the right lane. I wanted to move over to the left lane because my exit was coming up, so I checked my mirror and signaled.

Q: Did you see any vehicles in the lane you were moving into?

A: I looked, and I thought it was clear. There was a car a bit back, but it seemed far enough away. I started to move over and then I heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed.

Q: What happened after the contact?

A: The other car had come up alongside me faster than I expected. Our mirrors hit and my car drifted a little toward the shoulder. I corrected and pulled onto the shoulder, and the other driver pulled over ahead of me.

Q: Were you injured at the scene?

A: I felt stiff in my lower back right away, but I thought it would pass. By the next morning it was really painful, and I had trouble getting out of bed and bending over.

Q: Have you received any medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to a clinic the following day. They diagnosed a back strain, gave me muscle relaxers, and told me to rest and do physical therapy.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?

A: Yes, I still have pain when I sit for long periods, and I'm limited in lifting. I'm doing the therapy sessions and following the instructions the doctor gave me.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want my car and my back taken care of.

Q: Understood. This concludes the recorded statement. Thank you.

A: Thank you.
